title: Beautiful Curtain Rods
text: Beautiful Curtain Rods. I was looking for something to spruce up my living room. I previously had had some standard gold rods which really had seen better days along with cloth tie backs. I saw Levelor Sienna rods and holdbacks and decided to try them out. First the quality of them is amazing. Second, the color is dark and rich and looks so much nicer than the old gold ones. They make my living room look rich and have transformed the room from a standard looking room into a beautiful designer room. Thanks Levelor and Amazon. These are just what I needed!

product_metadata.title: Kenney 5872379 Classic Drapery Holdback, Brushed Sienna,One Pair
features: Pair includes two holdbacks, and mounting hardware for easy installation
For use with drapery or curtain panels
Classic design and finishes complement Levolor's decorative rod sets
Premium metal construction; finished with a durable metal plating for long lasting beauty
description: The Kenney Classic Drapery Holdbacks mount on each side of the window to casually draw draperies to the side, allowing more light into the room. The classic ball finial is a simple addition that will complement a broad range of decorative rod sets. Kenney Design Tip: A general guideline is to mount the holdback approximately 2/3 of the way down the drapery panel to make your draperies look taller and fuller. But to allow more light in, or create a more tailored look, the holdbacks can be mounted higher. Pair includes two holdbacks, and mounting hardware for easy installation. Classic design and finishes complement Levolor’s decorative rod sets. Premium metal construction; finished with a durable metal plating for long lasting beauty. Projects 4-1/2-inches from wall. Since the early 1900's Kenney has been setting the standard in window fashions, design innovation, product quality and customer satisfaction. Kenney remains the most recognized name in custom window coverings today. Kenney continues to offer great blinds and shades solutions in a wide variety of vertical, aluminum and wood blinds; cellular and woven wood shades; and sheer vertical window treatments. Kenney has expanded its product offering to include beautiful decorative drapery hardware, distributed nationally through home centers and other retailers.
